title: WorkPacket
description: Versioned dispatch contract (FR-2) for any role handed work by a coordinator, runtime-neutral. Contract version work-packet.v1. Formalises the fields already carried informally in Claude Code agent dispatch prompts; does not replace those prompts.
$comment: Required set kept minimal (spec §12.A Chunk A1) so existing Claude Code dispatches map cleanly without every field being mandatory up front. role/runtime are additive fields recording the target role (per references/runtime-roles.md, when introduced) and the runtime executing it (e.g. claude-code, openclaw).

feature_slug.description: Kebab-case build slug, matching the build-status.schema.json slug pattern.

objective.description: Bounded statement of what this dispatch must accomplish.

governing_artefacts.description: Paths to the spec, plan, or other artefacts governing this dispatch.

role.description: Runtime-neutral role name (e.g. builder, reviewer, architect) per references/runtime-roles.md.
